reasons.restricted_place: This connection processes or stores data in a restricted place, so it cannot be saved.
reasons.endpoint_not_allowed: This address is not allowed: vendors need HTTPS on a public host, and an address never contains a key.
reasons.adapter_mode_fake_only: This adapter only runs as a fake.
reasons.fake_holds_no_secret: Fake connections never hold a secret.
reasons.secret_store_unconfigured: The secret store has no key-encryption key yet, so no secret can be saved.
reasons.secret_required: A live vendor connection needs its secret before it can be enabled.
reasons.secret_not_found: The secret could not be read from its store.
reasons.secret_unreadable: The stored secret does not belong to this connection or was altered, so it was not used.
reasons.credential_not_active: The linked credential reference is not active in this hub.
reasons.test_required: Test the current configuration before enabling it.
reasons.test_failed: The last connection test did not pass.
reasons.connection_killed: A kill switch stops this connection; release it first.
reasons.revision_conflict: Someone changed this in the meantime. Reload and try again.
reasons.invalid_transition: This change is not possible in the current state.
reasons.route_unpinned: An active route names an exact model revision, never a moving alias such as "latest".
reasons.route_connection_unusable: Every model of the route must be on an enabled connection of this hub.
reasons.route_outside_residency: A route for non-public data must stay within the hub's data residency.
reasons.route_fallbacks_forbidden: Embedding and reranking routes have no fallbacks: results from different models never mix.
reasons.route_public_only: Image prompts may contain public data only.
reasons.route_budget_unknown: The spending cap of the route does not belong to this hub.
reasons.drafter_cannot_activate: A route that may carry non-public data is activated by someone other than the person who drafted it.
reasons.egress_training: A vendor that trains on inputs never receives non-public data.
reasons.egress_broker: A broker carries public data only.
reasons.egress_not_in_residency: Non-public data may only go to a connection that processes and stores it within the hub's residency.
reasons.egress_retention: Non-public data may only go to a provider that keeps nothing (zero retention).
reasons.cap_currency: A spending cap is set in the hub's currency.
reasons.cap_scope_unknown: The cap names something that does not belong to this hub.
reasons.kill_engaged: This kill switch is already engaged.
reasons.kill_not_engaged: This kill switch is not engaged.
reasons.pricing_currency: The cost record's currency is not accepted here.
reasons.adapter_unavailable: No adapter for this provider is installed on this node, so the connection cannot be tested.
reasons.decision_unknown: This call decision is unknown or already closed.
reasons.no_active_route: No active route serves this task, so the call is refused.
reasons.data_class_not_in_route: The route is not approved for this kind of data.
reasons.node_killed: A kill switch stops every call on this node.
reasons.route_killed: A kill switch stops this route.
reasons.job_killed: A kill switch stops this task.
reasons.module_killed: A kill switch stops this agent module.
reasons.extension_killed: A kill switch stops this extension.
reasons.pipeline_killed: A kill switch stops this pipeline.
reasons.egress_denied: The data may not leave the node for this connection.
reasons.no_available_connection: No connection of the route is available for this data.
reasons.cap_exhausted: A spending cap is reached: new paid calls are blocked.
reasons.currency_mismatch: The call's cost is not in the hub's currency.
reasons.no_rule: No rule allows this data class for this connection (denied by default).
reasons.denied: A rule denies this data class for this connection.
reasons.killed: A kill switch stops this connection.
reasons.residency: The connection processes or stores data outside the hub's residency.

dataClasses.deal_party_private: Private to the parties of a deal

secretStatus.grace: Previous key, still accepted until its grace period ends

capState.exhausted: Cap reached: new paid calls are blocked

console.title: Providers
console.lede: The operator's own services: connections, keys by reference, credentials and what each model costs. A secret is written once and never shown again.
console.hidden: This section is not available to you on this hub.
console.none: No connections yet. Nothing leaves the hub until a connection is tested, enabled and allowed by an egress cell.
console.addHelp: A connection starts as a draft. Test it, then enable it; a connection that is not fake needs a second person.
console.label: Name
console.modeHelp: Fake answers from the engine and calls nobody. A live adapter that the engine does not ship cannot pass its test.
console.storageHelp: Leave empty when nothing is retained.
console.endpointHelp: Optional. An address never contains a key.
console.credentialHelp: For a key kept outside the database; otherwise enter it on the connection.
console.vendorTermsValue: zero retention: {zero}; trains on inputs: {trains}; broker: {broker}
console.broker: A broker in front of other vendors
console.waiting: Waiting for a second person; asked by
console.approvedForOther: Approved; only the person who asked can finish it:
console.incidentHelp: The approval binds this note: use the same note to finish the release.

secret.title: Key
secret.fake: A fake connection holds no key.
secret.byCredential: The key is kept outside the database, under the credential of this connection.
secret.noReveal: A saved key is never shown again; only its fingerprint and state are.
secret.valueHelp: Sent once to the sealed store. It is not kept in this page.
secret.graceHelp: How long the previous key keeps working after a rotation, up to {max} hours.
secret.saved: Saved. The page shows its fingerprint.
secret.failed: The key was not saved. Nothing was stored; enter it again.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.help: A credential names where a secret lives outside the database. It holds the name, never the value.
credentials.hidden: Your roles do not show this hub's credentials.
credentials.refHelp: The name in that store, for example env:REGISTER_API. Never the secret itself.

costs.title: Model cost records
costs.help: What the operator pays. A cost is information: it never changes a sale price. A model needs a cost record before it can have a sale price.
costs.hidden: Your roles do not show the cost records.

egress.title: Egress
egress.lede: Which data classes may reach which connection. Everything not allowed here is denied.
egress.defaultDeny: A missing cell is a denial, for fake connections too.
egress.changeHelp: Allowing non-public data needs a second person, processing inside the residency and zero retention. After approval, choose the same cell again to finish.
egress.reviewHelp: The launch checklist reads this review. It is saved as a draft; another staff member asks for its activation and a second person approves it.
